opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations, exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of annual accounts; must meet eligibility quiz criteria.
opportunities.summary: Open to applications year‑round for operating/core cost, capital project or specific activity grants of up to £100,000. No submission deadline. Grants typically cover 10‑20% of an organisation’s annual budget or project costs.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities with annual income over £1 million, or projects/capital costs over £1 million; must meet eligibility quiz criteria and submit an Expression of Interest.
opportunities.summary: Major grants are considered at eight board meetings per year. Applications are accepted year‑round via an Expression of Interest with no deadline; successful EoIs are invited to submit a full proposal. Grants support core costs, capital projects or specific activities.
